create_session: create a new ACP session with a unique ID and a fresh AIAgent instance for a given working directory
get_session: retrieve an ACP session state by ID, transparently restoring from the database if not in memory
fork_session: deep-copy a session's conversation history into a new session with a fresh agent
list_sessions: list all ACP sessions from memory and database, optionally filtered by working directory
remove_session: remove an ACP session from both memory and the persisted database
